problems: ottoman-empire (me-10): its 1878-7 vassal_end events (ledger 196, 197) name principality-of-wallachia and principality-of-moldavia, which end in 1859; re-point them to united-principalities-of-moldavia-and-wallachia and add a vassal_start 1859-2. This dossier now carries vassal_start 1859-2 (confidence 3) and vassal_end 1877-5 (confidence 2, the infobox year; the legal end is Berlin, 13 July 1878).

principality-of-bulgaria (eu-18): its occupation_end for Dobruja is 1919-11 (Neuilly, confidence 1), outside this dossier's life; this dossier closes the pair at 1918-11 (confidence 1). Its 1918-5 gain of Southern Dobruja from this slug is read here as a paper transfer: the king never signed the Treaty of Bucharest (7 May 1918) and the Armistice of Compiegne nullified it on 11 November 1918, so no loss is recorded here.
german-empire has no dossier yet: three occupation pairs name it as counterpart (validator accepts the polities.csv slug).

Reviewer's Vrancea/Focsani suggestion was applied as a separate 1917-1 event with a 25 km Focsani radius, because the Romanian Campaign page dates the fall of Focsani to 8 January 1917, not December 1916.
Bukovina and Transylvania gains still name austria-hungary after its break-up; eu-20 decides whether that dossier reaches November 1918 or the counterpart becomes the Hungarian state.
first-hellenic-republic (verdict fix) and montenegro (verdict thin) were not touched in this pass.
